art_note: The model photography relies on heavy digital compositing and flat-looking mockups, detracting from the premium sportswear aesthetic.
desc_en: Redefine your presence on and off the field with this athletic-inspired cropped silhouette. Crafted from a lightweight and exceptionally soft technical fabric that delivers superior comfort and reliable shape retention. The design features a pronounced V-neckline and structured short sleeves. An essential piece for high-performance training or elevating daily downtime. Made to order with worldwide shipping available.
desc_es: Redefine tu presencia en el campo y fuera de él con esta silueta corta de inspiración deportiva. Confeccionada en un tejido técnico ligero y ultrasuave que ofrece una comodidad superior y una excelente recuperación de la forma. El diseño presenta un cuello en V acentuado y mangas cortas estructuradas. Una prenda esencial para entrenamiento de alto rendimiento o para elevar tu estilo diario. Pieza hecha a pedido con disponibilidad de envío internacional.
details_en:
· Crafted from soft and lightweight polyester
· Cropped silhouette with V-neckline

· Hand wash or machine wash with water under 45ºC
